description: State Highway System Intersection is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. As part of the Transportation System Network Replacement Project (TSNR), Highway Inventory module data migration, it was determined Caltrans would be utilizing Rizing’s Intersection Manager (IM) product to create and manage intersection data. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher Caltrans. Its tags are CAOpenData, CalSTA, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, Caltrans. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
